# AviUtl2 SDK headers

`plugin2.h` and `filter2.h` are copied without modification from the official
AviUtl ExEdit2 Plugin SDK archive published 2026-09-05 for AviUtl2 2.1.8.

- Source: `https://spring-fragrance.mints.ne.jp/aviutl/aviutl2_sdk.zip`
- Archive SHA-256: `c331616b4b9f4a29b46ed1fbd6cd8e4788a77fd32faee52702a426cdd52842c1`
- `plugin2.h` SHA-256: `9736c4efe46e1ea2fafe51265867d87cecb3a4c238f892bd8ac73e95445a0f21`
- `filter2.h` SHA-256: `ea74a4ddb96886db71bd5a83e97aa0f3b6f7b61648c1440267aa79ccb944ce83`

The SDK is MIT licensed. `filter2.h` owns the complete `PIXEL_RGBA` definition;
`plugin2.h` only forward-declares that callback pixel type.
